column1: # THE QUEUE SIMULATOR'S INVARIANTS (tests/sim_gate.py). One row per kind: its version, its definition's
# fingerprint, the number of the gate's fixed scenarios violating it (its baseline). A changed
# definition is a new version, in a commit of its own; a baseline only falls without one.

column5: what
one open item per change (worktree + head)
never two pushes of one change; never a decided change's commit pushed
a red fix is never behind a batch or a non-red change (its own tree, started and pushed when it may go)
a batch reaches landed, bisecting or held within its bound
the oldest change lands within a bound when nothing fails
no change lost (entries and items agree, LANDED is on main, every change decided after the drain)
exactly one agentctl.landing record per decided change
a change that no longer applies was told at queue time and never checked meanwhile
no full recheck for a file overlap with a change open when it was queued
no change held behind a queued one for generated files alone
no unverified combined tree reaches main
every queued or checked change past its deadline has a recorded hold
no change past its deadline is silent in `land status`
executors start in the documented priority order within a tick
no executor for a decided change
a red fix of an open gate red the store names never waits for green past N ticks
the queue never lands on a red gate a production commit naming no run of the open red
two holders reading no hold at once make exactly one hold, both report it and both moves are said
no overlap hold outlives its TTL while its holder is not in flight
